purpose: Cross-feature System Test package built from the QA baseline and Integration fixtures

reset_policy.before_suite: Reset the disposable QA database, then start the backend against beefcare_qa.
reset_policy.between_flows: Reset between flows that mutate the same cattle, payment, voucher or role state.
reset_policy.idempotency: Baseline writes use baseline-* and scenario writes use scenario-<fixture_id>-*.
reset_policy.readback: Record stable keys, IDs, status, version, farm ownership and derived reminders after each mutation.

flows.name: Account to farm herd dashboard
steps: Create or reuse the disposable verified owner account.
Register or select the QA farm and confirm the Owner membership.
Read the baseline cattle and pen context.
Open the dashboard and a herd report for the selected period.
expected_readback: Owner sees only the selected farm context.
Baseline cattle and pen counts match the normalized fixture readback.
Dashboard and report rows use the same farm and date filters.
No subscription or payment record is created by farm registration.
flows.reset_boundary: Reset after the account and farm lifecycle because the flow changes identity state.

flows.name: Care event to herd exit
steps: Create a health case and treatment for one active animal.
Record and correct a growth measurement for the same animal.
Read the recalculated health, withdrawal and growth state.
Create and confirm an exit voucher as Owner.
Open the dashboard or report after the exit.
expected_readback: Only VALID care and growth records affect current indicators.
The exit closes the open pen assignment and removes the animal from active totals.
The report reflects the exit date and excludes the animal after that date.
Manager and Technician access follows the role contract.
flows.reset_boundary: Reset after the flow because exit changes cattle status, pen assignment and derived reports.

flows.name: Reproduction to calving and reminders
steps: Record estrus and breeding for the baseline breeding female.
Record a pregnancy check and confirm the pregnancy episode.
Record calving with a live calf outcome.
Read the reminder list and reproduction report.
expected_readback: Reproductive status transitions follow the valid event order.
Expected calving and post-calving reminders use the configured dates.
The registered calf has the expected life stage, dam link and pen.
The report counts valid breeding, pregnancy and calving events once.
flows.reset_boundary: Reset after the flow because reproduction events and reminders are date-sensitive and stateful.

flows.name: Feed receipt to feeding reminder and report
steps: Read the baseline stock and low-stock reminder.
Post a feed receipt and verify stock movement.
Create an effective ration for QA-A.
Record a feeding session and refresh reminders.
Read the feed and management reports.
expected_readback: Posted receipt increases stock and leaves a traceable supplier and invoice.
The ration covers the feeding date and session.
The feeding record is VALID and reduces stock exactly once.
REM-10 and REM-11 resolve or reappear according to the resulting stock and session state.
Report totals use the same receipt, ration and feeding records.
flows.reset_boundary: Reset after the flow because receipt, ration and feeding mutations affect stock and reminders.

flows.name: Role change to announcement and support notification
entry_data: Owner, Manager, Technician and support actors
steps: Change a member role or active state and read the audit record.
Create and publish a named-recipient announcement.
Apply a correction and read the original recipient snapshot.
Open the recipient notification and mark it read.
Verify support or platform access with the changed role.
expected_readback: The role change applies from the next request and has an audit record.
The announcement has one immutable published version per correction.
Only the original eligible recipients receive the correction.
Notification read state is isolated per recipient.
Unauthorized farm or platform access is rejected.
flows.reset_boundary: Reset after the flow because membership and notification state affect later permissions.

flows.name: Payment evidence to cash and service reports
steps: Create a payment request or payable with a deterministic reference.
Attach or read back the bank transaction evidence.
Confirm or void the payment according to the selected case.
Read the service state, notification and cash report.
expected_readback: A payment evidence row is stored once by its reference.
Only an eligible payment changes the service state.
Voided payments remain in history and are excluded from new snapshots.
Owner and Manager report permissions match the feature contract.
Notification links target the correct payment or reconciliation record.
flows.reset_boundary: Reset after the flow because payment and subscription state changes report snapshots and access.
